definition: The learned numerical parameters of a neural network that determine how it transforms inputs into outputs.
details: Weights are adjusted during training via optimization algorithms like gradient descent, and collectively encode everything the model has 'learned' from its training data.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Model Weights.
